open_obligations: Note that Performance Recovered here uses Best-of-N over oracle Pass@N, not Burns et al.'s PGR.
Check the strong-to-weak result where direct critique wins.
Check whether the gains hold across the full 0.5B-72B sweep.
in.other_title: AI-AI: higher-order self-critique helps weak-to-strong supervision (Performance Recovered)
in.rationale: Lang, Huang and Li ask which other combinations of scalable oversight and weak-to-strong generalisation work. Wen et al. report that when supervised models are larger than a fixed 7B critic, higher-order critiques give better Performance Recovered, i.e. recursive critique helps a weaker overseer supervise a stronger model; the pipeline trains a reward model for Best-of-N, not a strong student finetuned on weak labels.
in.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether another scalable oversight method can be combined with weak-to-strong supervision, for recursive self-critique with Qwen2.5 models on math
